risks.risk: Haze, scratches, or internal dust on the front/rear glass affecting image quality
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of BOTH front and rear elements under bright light (no glare), plus a photo of the lens held at an angle to show scratches/dust.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible minor haze/marks (worst-case for image clarity).

risks.risk: AF motor not working / slow / noisy (common issue for used lenses)
risks.proof: Video clip of autofocus on a camera body (or phone screen showing focus change) and a short clip of manual focus ring movement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to autofocus (worst-case: treat as manual-only).

risks.risk: Aperture blades sticking or oil on blades causing exposure issues
risks.proof: Photo/video of aperture opening/closing while changing f-stops on a camera (or a clip showing smooth blade movement).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as aperture operation not confirmed (worst-case: assume it may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or damaged mount contacts
risks.proof: Photo of the lens mount side (contacts/threads) and what’s included (front cap, rear cap, hood if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may be missing caps/hood and mount condition not confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a sharp close-up of the rear element (rear glass) and the front element (both) under bright light.
Send a short video showing autofocus working on a camera body (or at least focus hunting/lock).
Send a video/photo showing aperture blades moving smoothly when changing f-stops.
Send a clear photo of the lens mount side (contacts/threads) and list included items (front/rear caps).
response.reason: The lens identity (Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G) is readable from the photos, but the seller’s condition claims (“clean like new”) and key functionality (AF, aperture, glass condition—especially rear element) are not verifiable from the provided images.
